visual.description: Animated reorder: the bar chart from scene-013 reshuffles from absolute $ (US first) to GDP % (Japan first). Japan bar glows #E06070 negative red at top: '1.86–2.92%'. US below: '1.56–2.28%'. Reorder animation makes the reveal dramatic. After bars settle, a cultural callout card slides in from right: 'Inemuri (居眠り) — sleeping while present. Tolerated as a sign of dedication.' in #E8E0D4 with 居眠り in #D47FA6.

notes: Key reveal moment — audience expects US to top every chart. Japan's GDP% range (1.86–2.92%) MUST show full range. Inemuri callout is cultural texture, not economic claim.
